summary: Frontend-only verification of 4 UI changes on EZtoFind.ca: (1) landing hero mascot image, (2) /visual-agent-demo thinking Doogie hero avatar, (3) BC-community datalists on Buyer/Seller area inputs, (4) top-nav no-overlap fix. All 4 items pass.

nav_overlap.1024px: identity hidden (display:none) per <=1180px media query; no overlap

buyer_datalist.submit_kelowna: Header updated to 'Buyer snapshot · Kelowna' with live stats (verified via screenshot; JSON-LD noise in text scrape)

seller_datalist.submit_surrey: Header updated to 'Comparable actives · Surrey' with 4397 comps, $1.47M median, $25K-$60M range — verified via screenshot

critical_code_review_comments: Doogie thinking image is served from customer-assets CDN (~1024px wide) rather than /images/doogie/ folder. Fine functionally but consider co-locating with other doogie assets for consistency.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All four UI changes in iteration 28 verified. Landing hero mascot renders at /images/doogie/doogie-laptop-hero.png; agent-page hero avatar swapped to Doogie-thinking IMG; buyer/seller area inputs each expose a <datalist> (buyer-bc-communities / seller-bc-communities) with 82 BC community options including the required ones; nav identity block hides via CSS media at <=1180px so it never overlaps links at 1440/1200/1024. No horizontal overflow at 390/1024/1200/1440.
